title: fritillaria lurida
intro: Fritillaria lurida, commonly known as yellow fritillaria, is a species of flowering plant in the lily family. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in China, for its therapeutic properties and health benefits. Fritillaria lurida is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, and is used to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Fritillaria lurida include alkaloids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
